body: **Foco:** Inverted hypothetical (Were I…) — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (pesquisa).
**Texto do dia:** entrevista.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir e revisar hipóteses invertidas (Were I, Were it not for, Were they to) numa entrevista sobre uma pesquisa.

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

items: conjunto de dados de longo prazo

blocks.intro: A climate scientist talks about a long-term study.
qa: **Were funding to stop**, we **would lose** forty years of data. **Were it not for** volunteers, the project **would be** impossible. **Were I** in charge of the budget, I **would protect** long-term records.
**Were I to start again**, I **would involve** local communities earlier. **Were they to feel** ownership, they **would share** more data.

items.q: Forty years of data could be lost.

blocks.body: Revise: (1) usou **were** (não *was*)? (2) **would** na oração principal? (3) tirou o **if**?

items.s: ___ funding to stop, we would lose forty years of data. (Were)
Were it not ___ volunteers, the project would be impossible. (for)
Were I in ___ of the budget, I would protect records. (charge)
Were they to feel ownership, they ___ share more data. (would)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.pt: conjunto de dados de longo prazo
items.expt: Conjunto de dados de longo prazo.

body: **In the long run.** — A longo prazo.
**Keep the lights on.** — Manter as atividades.
**Hang by a thread.** — Estar por um fio.
**Come rain or shine.** — Faça chuva ou faça sol.
**Tip of the iceberg.** — Ponta do iceberg.
**A drop in the ocean.** — Gota no oceano.
**Leave a legacy.** — Deixar um legado.
**Stand the test of time.** — Resistir ao tempo.
**What if funding stopped?** — E se o financiamento parasse?
**What would you change?** — O que mudaria?
**Were funding to stop, we would lose forty years of data.** — Se o financiamento parasse, perderíamos quarenta anos de dados.

blocks.title: Pronúncia: Organização da informação pela entonação

items.label: Organização da informação pela entonação
items.note: A entonação organiza o discurso: queda = informação completa; subida = há mais por vir; a informação nova recebe o foco (nuclear stress).

prompts.model: Were funding to end, we’d stop.
Were I in charge, I’d invest more.
Were it not for you, I’d fail.

blocks.task: Write 6 sentences answering an interviewer’s “what if…?” questions about a research project, using inverted hypotheticals.
blocks.model: Were funding to stop, we would lose forty years of data. Were it not for volunteers, the project would be impossible. Were I in charge of the budget, I would protect long-term records. Were I to start again, I would involve local communities earlier. Were they to feel ownership, they would share more data. Were the data to disappear, science would lose a valuable record.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
